purpose: Every dimension used by scripts/make_module_models.py (3D models for the sensor-mounting renders). These models are pictures, not fit evidence: the OpenLog / BMP280 fit is decided by the fit check from calliper dimensions (plan D15), not by a render.

tags.F: read from a named document or file (see sources); F says where the number comes from, not that the delivered part was measured
tags.A: assumed (no document for this exact part, or a number taken from a different part's document); measure with callipers before trusting it

entry_format: each dimension is {v: value, tag: F|A, src: key of sources (+ note)}

sources.openlog_brd: SparkFun OpenLog DEV-13712 Eagle board file hardware/OpenLog.brd from https://github.com/sparkfun/OpenLog (Eagle 7.5.0 XML, 108170 bytes): outline, element positions, pad positions, silk order and the '0.8mm Thin PCB' text
sources.hongcheng_c22436147: Hong Cheng HC-PM254-8.5H-1xNPW drawing, https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/7670a99c55984cf32080a39fb7ce1e6d.pdf?productCode=C22436147 (right-angle 2.54 mm socket fitted at J2 / J5)
sources.hanxia_c32713262: HANXIA PZ2.54-1xNP WZ right-angle pin header drawing, https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/310553b178618f94c3fe1fa804bc8d3d.pdf?productCode=C32713262 (a right-angle header family drawing; NOT the header on the delivered modules)
sources.jst_egh: JST GH connector catalogue eGH.pdf, https://www.jst-mfg.com/product/pdf/eng/eGH.pdf, pages 2 and 3 (reference values)
sources.jlc_c5364642: JLCPCB part record C5364642 (Molex 22035025), cached in out/reports/sourcing/LCSC_C5364642.json: X-Length 7.4 mm, Y-Width 4.9 mm, Z-Height 5.9 mm, Pitch 2.5 mm, Color White
sources.kicad_lib: KiCad 10.0.6 library files on disk (footprints/*.pretty/*.kicad_mod and 3dmodels/*.3dshapes/*.step); pad positions are re-read from the .kicad_mod at run time
sources.components101_bmp280: https://components101.com/sensors/gy-bmp280-module (GY-BMP280-3.3 family page; that the TYE-BMP29 is this board is A)
sources.indiamart_neo7m: https://www.indiamart.com/proddetail/neo-7m-gps-module-10408242112.html (generic NEO-6M / NEO-7M board; that the SZH-NT07 is this board is A)
sources.vehicle_params: params.json of this repository, configs.vtol.top_cap.gps (GY-NEO6MV2 = NEO-6M vendor data, kept for the SZH-NT07 as A)
sources.place_rev2c: pcb/vtol_carrier/scripts/place.py MODULES (rev 2c reserved outlines; all A there)
sources.none: no document - assumption of this file

openlog.what: SparkFun OpenLog DEV-13712; coordinates are Eagle board coordinates (x 0..15.24 along the header edge, y 0..19.05, top = ATmega328 side)

header_x.src: openlog_brd JP2 pads; silk GRN RXI TXO VCC GND BLK in this order

top_parts.src: openlog_brd element positions (centres); body sizes and heights below are A

microsd_socket_xy.src: x range and near edge from openlog_brd U3 drawing extent (bottom side, origin 14.732 / 3.429); the far end of the metal shell (y 18.4) is assumed

face_up.src: openlog_brd silk order + plan J5 pin 1 = GRN: GRN meets pin 1 only with the microSD side up, i.e. the ATmega side and the header plastic face the carrier (geometry, see mounting.J5)

neo7m.what: NEO-7M GPS module SZH-NT07 (devicemart 10895400); the outline in hand is the generic NEO-6M / NEO-7M board

antenna_ceramic_h.src: none (split of antenna_h into ceramic and base)

header_n.src: none: VCC GND TXD RXD (+PPS on some boards); physical order NOT_VERIFIED

gh_plug.what: JST GHR-04V-S housing with 4 crimped wires, mated on J7 (BM04B-GHS-TBT, JLC-fitted)

housing_len.src: jst_egh housing length in the mating direction

mated_h.src: jst_egh assembly layout, top entry type: (7.3) reference value

wire_od.src: jst_egh allows insulation OD 0.76 .. 1.0; the lead itself is not chosen

lead_rise.src: none: straight wire above the plug before the bend

lead_bend_r.src: none: bend radius of the wires (top of the bend = mated_h + lead_rise + lead_bend_r + wire_od / 2 = 12.75, kept under the 13.4 mm limit on purpose)

lead_run.src: none: only the first part of the lead is drawn on the board renders; it runs toward the board interior (footprint -y)

body_centre_y.src: centre of the header body in the kicad_lib footprint fab outline (y -2.5 .. 1.75)

j14_molex.what: Molex 22035025 (5267-02A), 2.5 mm 2-pin vertical header, JLC-fitted; the KiCad library has the footprint but no 3D model file on disk

body_x.src: jlc_c5364642 X-Length; equals the kicad_lib fab outline -2.45 .. 4.95

body_y.src: jlc_c5364642 Y-Width; equals the kicad_lib fab outline -3.1 .. 1.8

base_h.src: none (height of the shroud floor; inner shape is illustrative)

tail_below_board.src: none (drawn as board 1.6 + 1.4; the real tail length is NOT_VERIFIED, the Molex drawing was not read in this step)

height_limit.what: thin red frame drawn at the height limit above the board top in the side elevation b4 (a marker, not a part)

limit_above_board.src: plan: height limit 13.4 mm above the board top

board_x.src: plan: outline 76 x 70 mm (render_rev3.py checks the board edges against it)

bar.src: none: thickness of the marker bars

mounting.frame: connector footprint 3D frame: x = footprint x, y = -footprint y, z = up from the board top, origin = footprint origin; models are written in this frame and attached with offset 0 / rotation 0

J1.how: user solders the module's own straight 1x8 strip into the 8 plated holes; module flat, component side up, body toward footprint +x, VCC on pad 1

J2.how: module with a right-angle 1x6 header plugged into the right-angle socket; module lies flat, header plastic on the face toward the carrier

J5.how: user solders a right-angle 1x6 header (C55629820) on the ATmega side of the OpenLog and plugs it into the right-angle socket; microSD side up, card toward the far edge

J7.how: GHR-04V-S plug mated in the top-entry header, 4 wires straight up (lead to the NEO-7M on the top cap)

J14.how: replaces the missing library model in both render boards (JLC-fitted part)
